about: Segment masses and lengths for the body model (moonshot/body/skeleton.py). source: study | proposed, as in moonshot/thresholds.toml.

body_mass_kg.reason: About the ANSUR II 50th-percentile adult male; confirm against the ANSUR II tables

mass_fraction.reason: de Leva 1996, J Biomech 29(9):1223-1230, male (as reproduced by the Visual3D wiki)

thorax_head_fraction.reason: Everything above the lumbar pivot: de Leva 1996 head 6.94% + upper trunk 15.96% + middle trunk 16.33%; the subdivision is from memory, verify against the paper

girdle_kg.reason: Clavicle and scapula with their attached muscle, carried by the shoulder girdle's slide joints

length_mm.reason: ANSUR II 2012, 50th-percentile male, as trainual's motion/body_model.py derived them (acromion 1439 mm, biacromial 415 mm)
